description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelActor in the OpenClaw project, focusing on connection logic and error handling using mock WebSocket sessions.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of GatewayChannelActor connection handling and error responses.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session returning a predetermined response to simulate server interactions.

methods.name: concurrent connect is single flight on success
methods.description: Tests that multiple concurrent connection attempts result in a single WebSocket connection.

methods.name: concurrent connect shares failure
methods.description: Tests that concurrent connection attempts correctly handle failure cases without multiple connection attempts.

methods.name: connect surfaces structured auth failure
methods.description: Verifies that authentication failures are properly surfaced as structured errors containing detailed info.
